newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Arcadia surges after Sipa raises bid.
newsitem.headline: Arcadia surges after Sipa raises bid.

text.p: Shares in gold miner Arcadia Resources Ltd jumped 11 cents or 13 percent to 95 cents in active early Monday trade after its fellow miner in the Dublin Hill joint venture, Sipa International Resources Ltd, increased its takeover bid.
Sipa raised its offer late on Friday to seven Sipa shares and 40 cents cash for every four Arcadia shares from a straight five for three scrip offer.
The new offer values Arcadia's shares at 99.25 cents per share, given Sipa's current share price of 51 cents per share.
Sipa's shares were down one cent at 51 cents at 10.20 a.m. (0020 GMT).
The Dublin Hill joint venture in Western Australia, which includes the Mount Olympus prospect, is owned 30 percent by Arcadia and 70 percent owned by Sipa.
